fields.value: As the war rages on between Airatose and Sagon, a band of adventurers departs to join the war. However, their ship is damaged in a storm, and they stop on an undiscovered island known as Lamini. Lord Banniff gives the adventurers shelter and materials to repair their ship. On the eve of their departure, the adventurers discover something sinister about Lord Banniff. You must take control of one of the adventurers, each with relative strengths and weaknesses, and try to escape from Lord Banniff's castle. Explore 15 levels, battle hundreds of monsters, and find useful items and weapons. If exploring the castle by yourself becomes tedious, use a link cable and have a friend join the adventure. Try to escape from Lord Banniff in TOWERS: Lord Banniff's Deceit

Mientras la guerra entre Airatose y Sagon continúa, un grupo de aventureros parte para unirse al conflicto. Sin embargo, su barco sufre daños en una tormenta y se detienen en una isla desconocida llamada Lamini. Lord Banniff da refugio a los aventureros y les proporciona materiales para reparar su barco. En la víspera de su partida, los aventureros descubren algo siniestro sobre Lord Banniff. Debes tomar el control de uno de los aventureros, cada uno con fortalezas y debilidades relativas, e intentar escapar del castillo de Lord Banniff. Explora 15 niveles, enfréntate a cientos de monstruos y encuentra objetos y armas útiles. Si explorar el castillo por tu cuenta resulta tedioso, usa un cable link y haz que un amigo se una a la aventura. Intenta escapar de Lord Banniff en TOWERS: Lord Banniff's Deceit.
